subject: HIPAA keying model — pricing for HSM seats vs managed KMS
messages:
From: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@medsyn.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsyn.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HIPAA keying model — quick pricing ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week. Two follow-ups from our security & procurement teams:

1) Pricing model: we need a clear comparison between (A) managed KMS + audit-log retention add-on and (B) dedicated HSM seats (for customer-controlled keys). Please include list vs discounted pilot pricing, any implementation fees, and how audit-log storage/retention is billed (per GB / per month).

2) Evidence: our auditors want to understand how you deliver SOC2 evidence and HSM attestations — is that part of the add-on or a separate SOW?

3) Pilot ask: Medsyn would like a 3-month pilot (production traffic) for evaluation. Can you give terms you’d offer for pilot seats / KMS throughput and any credits we should expect if we convert to annual?

We’re on a tight procurement timeline: target PO by 2027-05-10. If you can share a draft SOW and line-item quote today/tomorrow that would be great.

Thanks,
Alex
Security Engineering — Medsyn Health
(attachment: Medsyn_RFP_2027_Q2.pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@medsyn.com>
Cc: procurement@medsyn.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA keying model — quick pricing ask

Alex — really appreciate the clear list. High-level options and what I attached: redwood-quote-medsyn-hipaa.xlsx (line-item pricing) and sow-hsm-kms-draft.pdf (draft SOW + evidence delivery notes). Summary below; happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through.

Option A — Managed KMS + Audit Logs (lowest friction)
- Managed KMS: no seat fees; key operations billed at $0.003 per 1k ops (est).
- Audit-log package: base tier $4,000/month includes 90-day retention and indexed query; longer retention billed $0.10/GB/month.
- Evidence: SOC2 artifacts included in standard security package; HSM attestation (if you require FIPS/HSM cert) appears as an add-on evidence bundle ($6k one-time for attestation package).

Option B — Dedicated HSM seats (customer key custody)
- List: $1,800/seat/month. Includes isolated key material and HSM access controls.
- Implementation: one-time onboarding & attestation SOW ($22,000 typical) to configure key escrow, cross-validation, and audit integration.
- Audit logs: same audit package above available; retention costs apply per GB.

Pilot proposal (what I recommend):
- 3-month pilot with 2 dedicated HSM seats (pilot rate we can offer: $1,200/seat/month) + audit log base tier at $3,000/month (pilot discount).
- Waive onboarding fee for pilot if Medsyn commits to converting to a 12-month reserved commitment within 60 days of pilot completion.

I attached a draft SOW that separates evidence delivery (we list SOC2, attestations, and audit-log export schedule) so your auditors have a clear artifact path. Also included a line-by-line quote.

If that aligns I’ll run this by pricing and legal for final approval; Ben (pricing) and Laura (revenue ops) are on copy.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-quote-medsyn-hipaa.xlsx)

Team — forwarding Medsyn’s ask and my recommended pilot concession (below). Need quick OK on discount and onboarding concession so I can return with a clean SOW. Original external message quoted at bottom.

Quick context: Medsyn is a mid-market telehealth provider aiming for PO 2027-05-10. Security wants clear evidence path and HSM-backed keys.

My recommendation for pilot:
- Pilot = 3 months; 2 HSM seats at $1,200/seat/month (pilot price).
- Audit-log base tier: $3k/month during pilot.
- Waive onboarding fee if they convert to 12-month reserved within 60 days of pilot end.

Ask: approve pilot pricing (seat concession from list $1,800 to $1,200) OR propose if legal needs the onboarding fee to be partially credited. Also confirm whether we can include a one-time attestation evidence bundle at $6k as a billable line (vs embedded free).

If you approve I’ll update the attached SOW + quote and send DocuSign link.

— Mina

Mina / team — I’m OK with a concession for the pilot but want to preserve conversion economics. Approvals below: 

- Pilot seat discount: approve 15% off list for up to 3-month pilot (list $1,800 => pilot $1,530/seat/month). If revenue ops wants a deeper concession for strategic reasons, route to me with rationale.
- Onboarding fee: don’t fully waive by default. Offer to credit the onboarding fee ($22k) back as a one-time credit if they sign a 12-month reserved commit within 60 days of pilot completion. For a pure 3-month pilot with no commit, give a 10% credit on the onboarding fee instead.
- Evidence bundle: billable line at $6k is fine. We should avoid embedding attestations for free unless there’s a clear strategic upside.

Mina — please update the quote to reflect a pilot seat at $1,530/seat/month and the onboarding credit terms. Send the updated SOW and a DocuSign link. Add the HubSpot deal link in the cover note.

Ben
Head of Pricing — Redwood Inference
